executor: Parent task in its serialized primary-checkout execution window
prerequisites: Resolve every missing input in backport/REVIEW.json and complete the source correction set before enabling a rebuild.
Resolve the reported frozen catalog mismatch and exact package-age gate through their owning workflow; do not disable policy globally.
Select the exact Puck Node in every new shell and verify it against the owning toolchain JSON; run pnpm only through the pinned runner.
Preserve source identity, Apache license and all third-party notices. Candidate provenance must distinguish stable baseline plus reviewed source backports from an upstream unmodified stable release.

providerRegressionInputs.registration: Import registerProviderRegressionInputs from a parent-owned node:test wrapper; explicitly supply test, packageRoot and reviewed targetConstructorLayout. This input does not auto-register on import and has not run.
providerRegressionInputs.control: Run against original stable package and require the two missing commands/metrics assertions to fail for their expected causes; run against the exact integrity-verified reference for behavioral comparison. A load/import error is not a successful defect reproduction.
providerRegressionInputs.candidate: Run against the rebuilt candidate. These inputs exercise real provider constructors, configuration storage, processors, parser and target methods. Only external CDP calls are doubled. They are unit/contract evidence, never browser evidence.
providerRegressionInputs.scopeLimit: These six inputs do not exhaust dispatcher, lifecycle, inheritance, OOPIF, worker, cache, browser or emitted-export acceptance. Additional cases below remain mandatory.

additionalContractProof: Drive real CommandProcessor/BidiServer through BiDi transport and the validating parser for both commands. Assert success/error result IDs, channels, error codes, unsupported feature handling and CDP rejection propagation.

Use real BrowsingContextImpl and CdpTarget graphs for context and user-context isolation, global inheritance, per-context precedence, null clearing, duplicates, missing/empty/both selectors, iframe rejection and target creation after configuration.

Assert media payload filtering and complete resets across pages/OOPIFs; assert viewport meta survives viewport, DPR, screen/orientation and scrollbar changes and that worker targets do not receive unsupported domains.

Prove per-context cache persistence on child/replacement targets, custom/browser CDP event forwarding, window state transitions, preload channels by sandbox, navigation/realm replacement, popup and download lifecycle behavior identified in REVIEW.json.

exports.cjs: Use actual require() on the rebuilt package under selected Node; assert BidiMapper.BidiServer.createAndStart, EventEmitter, OutgoingMessage and Protocol exports, and exercise the exact Puppeteer connectBidiOverCdp argument/interface path.
exports.esm: Import through the package entrypoint and all currently consumed subpaths; compare runtime export keys with the stable baseline and reference. Exercise actual mapper startup and transport responses, not only symbol existence.
exports.mapperTab: Load the rebuilt mapperTab in real Chromium through the provider's tab transport, complete session creation and both command round trips. Check browser globals and independent frame/worker behavior. Loading the Node mapper alone does not cover the IIFE.
exports.types: Compile regression-inputs/exports.type-input.ts plus the installed Puppeteer adapter/interface consumers using catalog TS7 in Node and browser configurations. Check CJS/ESM declarations and all published type subpaths. No declaration hand edits or skipped library checking as substitute proof.

actualBrowser: Use Chrome and chrome-headless-shell at the exact observed native revision and Firefox's observed native revision from generator-inputs.json. Verify executable/product versions at runtime and preserve all revision source hashes.

Exercise Chromium BiDi-over-CDP through Puppeteer with real session.new, page/context create, navigation, evaluate, events, cookies, screenshot/PDF, network interception/auth/cache, CDP sessions/events, dialogs, viewport, workers/OOPIFs, downloads and existing smoke behavior. Existing expected unsupported results must not silently become success or lost capability.

Send both emulation commands through the real transport: check matchMedia for every supported feature, invalid/unsupported inputs, feature reset, viewport-meta-only behavior with a real viewport meta document, combined metrics, reload/navigation, new targets and context isolation.
Exercise the rebuilt mapperTab path separately from the Node mapper path. Run headful window transition checks separately where the window manager can provide meaningful bounds.
Run Firefox's existing native BiDi coverage without routing it through the Chromium mapper. Preserve its existing supported and expected unsupported behaviors.
reproducibilityAndRegistrationGate: Two clean matching builds and patch hashes, complete package/notice/export/type coverage, real browser acceptance, and parent review are required before any production catalog/lock/patch/override registration.
nonEvidence: No tests, typechecks, builds, generator, patched install, browser or compatibility acceptance has executed in this sidecar.
